_doc: Bar glass (#866; refs experiments/prop_lab/refs/saloon/): a beer schooner of 10 oz, a tall flared bowl on a short stem and a round foot (the Wainwright advertising glass's shape), a head on its beer. A prop that shatters (GlassProp), as the whiskey bottle: a ball, a fall faster than 3.5 m/s (a heavy glass off the bar onto the boards: some do, some don't) or 40 kPa breaks it, and what's in it goes on the floor (`Events.liquid_spilled`). The glass the kit's `glass:flint` (see-through, its thick outline catching the lamps; no shadow of its own); what's in it baked the gun way (tools/blender/props/saloon_s1.py). One physics body standing (the frozen glass; a shelf of forty is forty bodies: set a row on the back bar sparingly), its shards when it breaks. Written by tools/props/saloon.py.
